title: Teaching AI Agent to Play Poker Strategically Through Preference Optimization
abstract: arXiv:2610.27028v1 Announce Type: new  Abstract: A poker agent can make a legal move and still make a strategically poor one. We ask whether compact AI agents can exhibit strategic behavior under hidden information and whether preference optimization can improve beyond static and zero-shot policies. We first evaluate a static baseline and three frozen language models: SmallThinker, Qwen3, and Gemma-3 whose performance varies substantially between exact-game and six-player evaluation. We therefore propose Strategic Preference Optimization with KL-anchored Equilibrium (SPOKE), combining teacher-relative value penalties, policy anchoring, risk constraints, and structured rationale supervision, and compare it with SFT, DPO, GRPO, and GSPO. Across three runs of a SmallThinker-4B-A0.6B policy, SPOKE achieves the lowest mean exploitability in Kuhn (0.213) and Leduc (1.081) and the highest six-max top-1 agreement (0.775), while maintaining teacher KL comparable to SFT (0.522 vs 0.523). translated_title: 通过偏好优化教会AI智能体策略性地玩扑克
translated_abstract: 一个扑克智能体可以做出合法的行动，却仍然是策略上糟糕的行动。我们探究紧凑型AI智能体能否在隐藏信息条件下展现出策略性行为，以及偏好优化能否超越静态和零样本策略。我们首先评估了一个静态基线和三个冻结的语言模型：SmallThinker、Qwen3和Gemma-3，它们在精确博弈评估和六人局评估中的表现差异很大。因此，我们提出了带KL锚定均衡的策略偏好优化方法（SPOKE），该方法结合了教师相对价值惩罚、策略锚定、风险约束和结构化推理监督，并将其与SFT、DPO、GRPO和GSPO进行比较。在SmallThinker-4B-A0.6B策略的三次运行中，SPOKE在Kuhn扑克中取得了最低的平均可利用性（0.213），在Leduc扑克中为（1.081），并取得了最高的六人局top-1一致率（0.775），同时保持了与SFT相当的教师KL值（0.522 vs 0.523）。
tldr: 提出SPOKE方法，通过融合教师相对价值惩罚、策略锚定、风险约束和结构化推理监督的偏好优化技术，使小型AI智能体在隐藏信息的扑克博弈中学会策略性行为，并显著降低可利用性。
en_tdlr: Proposes SPOKE, a preference optimization method combining teacher-relative value penalties, policy anchoring, risk constraints, and structured rationale supervision, enabling compact AI agents to exhibit strategic poker play under hidden information with significantly reduced exploitability.
